component.name: mpc-rv
component.summary: Media player in the spirit of Media Player Classic

description.p: mpc-rv is an unofficial rewrite of Media Player Classic - Home Cinema (MPC-HC) for Linux, in Rust, with libmpv for playback and GTK4 for the interface. It is not MPC-HC and isn't affiliated with its developers.
It keeps what MPC-HC users know:

ul.li: MPC-HC's menus, keyboard shortcuts and command line switches, with every key remappable
Playlist with MPC's playlist format, M3U, PLS, ASX and CUE
Subtitle styling, delay and a subresync bar to fix timings
Zoom, pan and scan, aspect ratio and MPC's pixel shaders
DVD and Blu-ray folders, audio CDs, capture devices and DVB TV
Media keys and desktop media controls (MPRIS)

description.p: Subtitles use a smaller default font size.
The screen no longer switches off while a video plays. Keyboard seeking and volume show the control bar, and volume changes show the new level on the video.
New control bar in the style of web players: it sits over the video, hides while the mouse is still, and has a thin seek bar with white controls.
First release: playback, playlist, settings, tracks and subtitles, video tools, discs and devices, MPRIS and translations.
